meaning: The bad one makes the good hard to recognise — a warning against hypocrisy
note: Also given as “Papani amma yeanhu kramo”. The form resembles Solomon’s knot, but the Akan reading compares the two links rather than dwelling on their endlessness.
aliases: Kramo Bone Amma Yeanhu Kramo Pa
references: Willis, W. Bruce. The Adinkra Dictionary: A Visual Primer on the Language of Adinkra (1998)
